comparison.objective: Shelve four drug cartons upright and front-facing while separating two look-alike cartons.
comparison.physical_skill: Carton grasping, quarter-turn reorientation, pocket insertion, and safety-constrained placement planning.
comparison.success_condition: Cartons occupy rack pockets upright with wide faces forward, and the look-alikes are neither co-located nor adjacent; numeric pose tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: Rack placement under a look-alike separation rule is meaningfully different from tang break-off, insert retention, and fragment recovery.
